description: This file contains unit tests for various grain placement strategies in an Orleans-based distributed system, including random, prefer local, and stateless worker placement strategies.

classes.name: GrainPlacementTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying different grain placement strategies in Orleans, including default, random, prefer local, and stateless worker placements.

methods.name: VerifyDefaultPlacement
methods.description: Tests that the default grain placement strategy results in a ResourceOptimizedPlacement.

methods.name: RandomlyPlacedGrainShouldPlaceActivationsRandomly
methods.description: Verifies that grains are placed on different silos randomly.

methods.name: PreferLocalPlacedGrainShouldPlaceActivationsLocally_TwoHops
methods.description: Checks that grains with prefer local placement are placed on the same silo as their requesting grains.

methods.name: CollectActivationIds
methods.description: Collects activation IDs from a grain sample.

methods.name: ActivationCount
methods.description: Counts the number of distinct activations for a grain sample.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerShouldCreateSpecifiedActivationCount
methods.description: Verifies that stateless worker grains create activations within specified limits.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerGrainShouldCreateActivationsOnLocalSilo
methods.description: Ensures that grains with a stateless worker placement create activations on the local silo.
